Text.Text: The case is complete and the crew's lockdown is broken. Your hazard pay is approved. You've finished my Scrapheap Lockdown trials. I have no further work for you here.
Clearance requires rank 50 in Katar. Reach that rank, then report back. The sealed yard needs a trained response.

A crew sealed the lower yard and is drilling under a work order my office never issued. Recover the forgery so I can trace who authorized the lockdown. Defeat six Scrapheap Lockdown Adepts in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Scrapheap Lockdown Breaker Yard Work Order; bring it back to me here in CZ-220, Hangar. I'll give you the CZ-220 Breaker Yard Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Scrapheap Lockdown.

Here's the CZ-220 Breaker Yard Key. Use 'Enter the Breaker Bay' in CZ-220, Maintenance Level. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Scrapheap Lockdown Adepts, then return with the Scrapheap Lockdown Breaker Yard Work Order.

From the inside. Lockdown protocol seals trouble in - it should never seal me out. Someone rewrote the sequence so my override reads as the intrusion. My own doors treat me as the breach. That isn't a hack, it's authorship. Only a few people alive understand the protocol well enough to turn it inside out, and I wrote most of that list myself.

Katar containment work. Lockdown doctrine - you don't chase the fight, you close the room around it until nothing inside moves without your permission. Done right, it's the cleanest discipline I ever cleared a permit for. Done down there, off the books, behind my own doors, it's a weapon program with this yard's name on the liability line.

On its own, nothing - paper is paper. But a forgery is a confession with a signature. Stamp codes, routing marks, the requisition chain: every line tells me who inside my perimeter fed them formats, schedules, and door timings. I don't need it to convict the six you're about to meet. I need it for the ones you won't.
Defeat six Scrapheap Lockdown Adepts in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Scrapheap Lockdown Breaker Yard Work Order; bring it back to me here in CZ-220, Hangar.
You've defeated six Scrapheap Lockdown Adepts. Let me see the Scrapheap Lockdown Breaker Yard Work Order.
Record recovered. We can trace the orders now. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists are controlling the junkline through its relay. Recover it and cut their access to the machinery. Defeat five Scrapheap Lockdown Specialists in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Scrapheap Lockdown Junkline Control Relay; bring it back to me here in CZ-220, Hangar.
Your key still grants access to CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Defeat five Scrapheap Lockdown Specialists to secure the Scrapheap Lockdown Junkline Control Relay, then return to me.

An engineered one. Every bay is rigged against every other bay - belts, gates, pressure doors, cross-wired so touching one wakes three. My response protocols assume a threat that wants out. This crew wants to stay in. Holding sealed ground is the whole doctrine they're drilling. The stand-off isn't their defense. It's their thesis.

Two things. It's the switch their moving walls hang from - pull it and their perimeter goes from active to static, which is the difference between fighting a machine and fighting furniture. And it's serial-logged. The maintenance record will show me when it was accessed and under whose credentials. Hardware doesn't lie. That's why I prefer it to people.

My response teams are holding the upper yard so the occupation stays contained. I don't have a spare team to send below. I recommend taking two companions for the harder fights; that's practical advice, not a clearance rule.
Defeat five Scrapheap Lockdown Specialists in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Scrapheap Lockdown Junkline Control Relay; bring it back to me here in CZ-220, Hangar.
You've defeated five Scrapheap Lockdown Specialists. Let me see the Scrapheap Lockdown Junkline Control Relay.
Equipment recovered. Their training operation is disrupted. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden enforces the crew's containment orders. Recover his bay sigil and break that control. Defeat the Scrapheap Lockdown Warden in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Scrapheap Lockdown Sheared Bay Sigil; bring it back to me here in CZ-220, Hangar. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In CZ-220, Breaker Bay, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Scrapheap Lockdown Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Scrapheap Lockdown Sheared Bay Sigil.

Nothing, which tells me everything. Every feed dies at the same threshold - not jammed, ended. The last frame probe six sent was him standing in the exact center of the bay, arms down, waiting. Fourteen hours later, probe seven sent the same frame. He doesn't patrol. He doesn't sleep where I can measure it. He is the lockdown.

Commissioning law. The oldest docks on this station predate my office, and their emergency systems answer to bay sigils - physical authority, no network to subvert. Whoever wears the sheared bay's plate is the sheared bay, as far as the old machinery cares. Elegant. Also the single point of failure in their entire occupation, hung on the one man they're certain can't be taken. I'm paying you to audit that assumption.

No. Not yet. I give you a name, you carry it down there, and a name changes how you fight - you start looking for a face instead of an opening. I'll say this much: the lockdown below wasn't subverted. It is running exactly as designed, by the man who designed it. Deal with the warden first. The rest of that sentence is waiting at the bottom of the yard.

Defeat the Scrapheap Lockdown Warden in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Scrapheap Lockdown Sheared Bay Sigil; bring it back to me here in CZ-220, Hangar. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Scrapheap Lockdown Warden. Let me see the Scrapheap Lockdown Sheared Bay Sigil.
Warden defeated. That breaks their enforcement. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four officers still have the override authority to keep the yard sealed. Bring me their chip. Defeat four members of the Scrapheap Lockdown Inner Circle in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Scrapheap Lockdown Foreman's Override Chip; bring it back to me here in CZ-220, Hangar.
Your key still grants access to CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Defeat four members of the Scrapheap Lockdown Inner Circle to secure the Scrapheap Lockdown Foreman's Override Chip, then return to me.

The others were recruits. These four are believers. Each one can hold a sealed room alone until thirst wins - I've watched them drill exactly that on the feeds I still have. They eat facing the doors. They sleep in coverage arcs. And they have never once tripped one of my sensors by accident. If the man who trained them is who I believe, these four are his footnotes. Footnotes are where the dangerous details live.

The Scrapheap Lockdown Inner Circle fight together. Bring help if you can, and focus on one opponent at a time. Defeat four members to secure the Scrapheap Lockdown Foreman's Override Chip; simultaneous kills aren't required.

The master was my predecessor. He wrote the station's lockdown protocol, resigned, then went below decks to teach it to this crew. I signed a report saying he'd left the station because the truth was harder to explain. When the circle falls, he's the last part of that false report to correct.
Defeat four members of the Scrapheap Lockdown Inner Circle in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Scrapheap Lockdown Foreman's Override Chip; bring it back to me here in CZ-220, Hangar.
You've defeated four members of the Scrapheap Lockdown Inner Circle. Let me see the Scrapheap Lockdown Foreman's Override Chip.
Their officers no longer control the authorizations. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

The master is the last person enforcing the lockdown. Defeat him in the Breaker Yard to close the case. Defeat the Scrapheap Lockdown Master in CZ-220, Breaker Yard. Report back to me here in CZ-220, Hangar; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In CZ-220, Breaker Yard, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Scrapheap Lockdown Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

Because the protocol was never about the yard. I've read his early drafts. Lockdown, the way he wrote it, is a promise: nothing gets past me. Not the fight, not the fear, not one thing he ever failed to contain. A man makes enough of those promises and eventually he builds a room shaped like himself and keeps the last promise from inside it. He didn't subvert my station. He finally filed himself where he always belonged.

I recommend two companions against the Scrapheap Lockdown Master. Spread the pressure so one person doesn't have to carry the whole fight. You can enter alone, but prepare carefully before you call the challenge.
It means I can finally correct the report I signed when he disappeared. I'll give the full account under my own name, whatever it costs. A security office can't run on records it knows are false.

Defeat the Scrapheap Lockdown Master in CZ-220, Breaker Yard. Report back to me here in CZ-220, Hangar; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Scrapheap Lockdown Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The case is complete and the crew's lockdown is broken. Your hazard pay is approved. You've earned the right to train Scrapheap Lockdown. Your final payment is ready.
Back to the incident.
I'll defeat six Scrapheap Lockdown Adepts.
How does a crew lock you out of your own protocol?
What kind of drills need a sealed deck?
What does one forged flimsi actually prove?
I don't take work from people mid-interrogation. Not today.
Here's the Scrapheap Lockdown Breaker Yard Work Order.
About the relay.
I'll defeat five Scrapheap Lockdown Specialists.
A stand-off made of belts. Explain that.
What does the relay give you?
Why not send your own response teams?
Time their rotation again. I'll be back for it.
Here's the Scrapheap Lockdown Junkline Control Relay.
Back to the warden.
I'll defeat the Scrapheap Lockdown Warden.
What did your lost probes tell you about him?
How does a plate on his chest command your systems?
You said you know who trained them. Say the name.
I only count two of us today. I'll return at three.
Here's the Scrapheap Lockdown Sheared Bay Sigil.
Back to the chip.
I'll defeat four members of the Scrapheap Lockdown Inner Circle.
What separates the circle from the rest?
Why does one chip outrank your entire office?
It's time. Tell me who is at the bottom of the yard.
Four dug-in believers takes planning. Keep the file open.
Here's the Scrapheap Lockdown Foreman's Override Chip.
Back to the last charge.
I'll face the Scrapheap Lockdown Master and report back.
Why does a man lock himself inside his own protocol?
What exactly am I walking into down there?
And when he's gone - what does that make you?
Not yet. When my three is certain, I'll go down.
The Scrapheap Lockdown Master is defeated. Here's my report.
